qualification_rule: V3 code may be called implemented after its software gates pass, but stage-correct IBASS/CIMEX NAS and research claims remain NO-GO until V3-G13 records a verified qualifying decision.

gates.title: IBASS namespace and schema contract
pass_criteria: V3 has an isolated namespace, strict 12-integer semantic codec, serialization, and explicit CLI route
V1 and V2 tests remain unchanged and passing
The environment and clean source revision are captured
gates.rationale: V3 extends BASS in a separate package; it must not mutate the V2 scientific contract.

gates.title: Exact V2-subspace embedding
pass_criteria: For none/none, V3 delegates to the identical V2 graph and parameter names/count
With identical seeds, every weight and output is exactly equal for every case
Enabled exchange can never be silently projected to V2
gates.rationale: This exact subspace is what makes IBASS an extension of BASS rather than a new unrelated SR architecture.

gates.title: CIMEX primitive invariants
pass_criteria: The explicit alpha=0 boundary is bitwise identity while alpha itself receives a finite nonzero learning signal
At the released small nonzero initialization and after gate updates, every trainable CIMEX path has finite connected gradients
Branch permutation equivariance, zero-sum corrections, arbitrary shapes, mixed precision, deterministic seeds, and save/load pass
gates.rationale: The released 0.01 gate avoids making enabled exchange invisible to the current one-step proxy. Exact zero remains a required boundary and ablation, but requiring nonzero projection gradients at that boundary would contradict the chain rule.

gates.title: Stage-aware canonical equivalence gate
pass_criteria: Every one-branch state in all four exchange-barrier masks preserves its expanded operation trace inside each barrier-delimited segment
Internal skips and repeat runs never cross an enabled exchange, while disabled boundaries retain exact V2 compression
Raw and canonical stage-aware graphs agree numerically for every accepted equivalence pair and the Round-3 counterexamples remain structurally distinct
gates.rationale: Codec round trips can pass under a wrong quotient. This gate independently tests that canonicalization preserves the phenotype around CIMEX boundaries.

gates.title: One-million-draw IBASS structural audit
pass_criteria: Codec round trips and canonicalization are idempotent for every draw
No canonical aliases survive branch symmetry or algebraically inactive exchanges
Exchange-state priors, mutation reachability, family/width/depth distributions, and duplicate rates are reported
gates.rationale: Centered exchange followed by no downstream branch transform cancels at final addition and must be canonicalized away, not counted as diversity.

gates.title: Five-hundred-model IBASS executable gate
pass_criteria: Exactly 500 distinct canonical architectures cover none/k8/k16, both sites, widths, families, repeats, and boundary phenotypes
All cases have correct finite output and finite connected gradients under the gate-aware rule from V3-G02
There are zero unexplained failures and every failed seed/architecture is retained
gates.rationale: The current cyclic sampler is only a starting point; the qualifying cohort must prove actual joint-stratum coverage.

gates.title: Ten-thousand-model IBASS compute profile
pass_criteria: Params and traced graph FLOPs exist for every architecture or an explicit retained failure
Synchronized latency reports raw samples after warm-up on fixed shapes
Cost is reported by width, unit family, exchange site, k, and V2-subspace status
gates.rationale: O(3HWk) is an asymptotic design claim, not a measured efficiency result.

gates.title: IBASS target-device memory gate
pass_criteria: The target device, memory budget, batch, precision, and input size are preregistered
Peak inference and Adam-step memory are measured in fresh processes
OOMs remain in the denominator and no qualifying case exceeds budget
gates.rationale: IBASS cannot claim lightweight deployment from parameter count alone.

gates.title: IBASS proxy calibration and bias gate
pass_criteria: The plan was frozen before trained outcomes and defines task-specific stability/rank thresholds
Each proxy reports finite rate, seed sensitivity, runtime, and correlations with cost, family, width, k, site, and exchange count
No aggregate is used until individual proxies pass held-out short-training validation
gates.rationale: A V2 proxy can become an exchange detector or model-size proxy in V3; reuse without recalibration is invalid.

gates.title: CIMEX mechanism ablations
pass_criteria: Consensus/innovation, centered/uncentered, self/all/other reads, zero/small gate, shared/unshared projections, and simple mean/concatenation exchange controls are isolated one factor at a time
Matched-cost means both Params and FLOPs are within 5 percent; otherwise the pair is labeled unmatched and cost is modeled
Algebraically null combinations are forbidden and never interpreted as negative evidence
gates.rationale: A kitchen-sink factorial would mix non-identifiable and mathematically null variants; the staged matrix tests causal claims.

gates.title: CIMEX placement and search-gene ablations
pass_criteria: None, early-only, late-only, both, k8, k16, fixed exchange, and searchable exchange are compared
Every enabled exchange has a downstream branch-specific transform so centered updates cannot cancel at fusion
Quality, convergence, branch similarity, gate growth, update norms, Params, FLOPs, latency, and memory are reported
gates.rationale: This stage asks whether CIMEX belongs in BASS and whether it should be searched, after mechanism viability is established.

gates.title: Matched-recipe fixed-architecture SR evidence
pass_criteria: V2 and V3 are compared under identical data, degradation, initialization, optimizer, schedule, and evaluation
Three seeds and confidence intervals are retained for PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS if preregistered, and all cost metrics
CIMEX shows a practically meaningful held-out benefit or V3 is revised/rejected
gates.rationale: Novel machinery without matched SR evidence is architecture decoration, not progress.

gates.title: Multi-seed IBASS sensitivity search and optimizer cross-validation
pass_criteria: Five common identical-budget seeds per condition report uniqueness, mutation reachability, exchange/family drift, cache behavior, and objective correlations
Complete-canonical uniform, exchange-neutral, complexity-stratified, and one-factor exchange-mutation sensitivity conditions are preregistered and reported separately
Reference-direction selection matches an independent trusted implementation and selected candidates are not explained only by width, cost, prior, or exchange-count bias
gates.rationale: The search must show that CIMEX conclusions survive declared prior and mutation choices; new genes being reachable is necessary but not sufficient.

gates.title: IBASS research authorization
pass_criteria: Every mandatory gate has a byte-verified qualifying PASS and all deviations, OOMs, exclusions, and negative results remain visible
The novelty review claims only the searchable function-preserving BASS integration, not novelty of every ingredient
The signed decision states GO, REVISE, or NO-GO and authorizes only claims supported on a quality-compute-latency-memory Pareto comparison
gates.rationale: V3 may exceed BASS V2 only if the complete Pareto evidence does; the protocol does not predeclare a SoTA result.
